security_justification.audit_integrity: Preserves all 24 canonical event structures, validation constraints, and required fields while mediating host time and identity through verified provider SPIs.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Retains all 35 brand constructors and 19 brand kinds in Core, ensuring caller-claimed attributes cannot bypass authority validation.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The module-copy WeakMap registry invariant is preserved; duplicate-Core instances fail closed before sink handoff under Option C.
security_justification.concurrency: The ContextProvider SPI enforces isolated asynchronous context scopes; nested and concurrent operations cannot leak context data.
security_justification.confidentiality: No secret tokens, payloads, or sensitive diagnostics are retained or disclosed across provider interfaces.
security_justification.cryptography: Identifier generation requires cryptographically random UUIDs via the AuditIdentifierProvider interface without hardcoding Node crypto.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Safe error categories and bounded paths are preserved; provider rejections cannot leak raw host exceptions or memory dumps.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security exporters, transports, collectors, or SIEM sinks are authorized or introduced.
security_justification.fail_posture: Missing context, duplicate Core copies, and invalid schema data fail closed before event emission or sink handoff.
security_justification.lifecycle: Timer provider manages shutdown drain cleanly; handles without unref() degrade gracefully without hanging host processes.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Core maintains immutable configuration snapshots and read-only event structures; provider results are validated before use.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Prohibited-data detection and privacy-transformation hooks remain strictly inside Core and execute identically across all hosts.
security_justification.resource_retention: Context cleanup on scope exit and timer disposal prevent memory leaks or process retention.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No network delivery, retry, redelivery, queue, or buffering mechanisms are introduced.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The boundary between host platform capabilities and semantic audit logic is formalized through explicit SPI contracts.
